item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json, pathlib, work\\npolicy=json.loads(pathlib.Path('policy.json').read_text())\\nrequests=json.loads(pathlib.Path('requests.json').read_text())\\nactual=[work.evaluate(request, policy) for request in requests]\\nreport=json.loads(pathlib.Path('report.json').read_text())\\nassert report == actual, (report, actual)\\nassert work.evaluate({'layers':[{'enabled':False},{'retries':0},{'label':''}]}, policy) == {'ok':True,'config':{'enabled':False,'retries':0,'label':''},'error':None}\\nassert work.evaluate({'layers':[{'extra':1}]}, policy) == {'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'unknown_key'}\\nassert work.evaluate({'layers':[{'retries':True}]}, policy) == {'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'type'}\\nassert work.evaluate({'layers':[{'retries':None}]}, policy) == {'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'type'}\\nassert work.evaluate({'environment':{'retries':'4'}}, policy) == {'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}\\nprint('report and policy checks passed')\"]}"}
